note: Third-party product names that must not appear anywhere Cordly owns. They are stored as SHA-256 hashes of the lowercased token rather than as plain text, because a denylist written in plain text is itself an occurrence of the thing it forbids — the file would fail its own check, and a workspace-wide search for the name would keep finding it here forever. tools/check-hygiene.mjs tokenises each file the same way and compares hashes. To add a name: node -e "console.log(require('node:crypto').createHash('sha256').update('<name in lowercase>').digest('hex'))" and paste the digest below with a description that does not name it.
